nodes.Name: Lgamma
nodes.DocComment:
Lgamma returns the natural logarithm and sign (-1 or +1) of [Gamma](x).

Special cases are:

	Lgamma(+Inf) = +Inf
	Lgamma(0) = +Inf
	Lgamma(-integer) = +Inf
	Lgamma(-Inf) = -Inf
	Lgamma(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: sinPi
nodes.DocComment: sinPi(x) is a helper function for negative x
